ns2:course.label: Special Topics in Health Technology
ns2:course.description: Lecture course in topics of current interest in Health Technology; specific subject/topic will be announced in the Class Schedule. 1 to 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated up to 8 hours in the same semester to a maximum of 12 hours in subsequent semesters, if topics vary.
